What is Locked Earn?
Locked Earn is a fixed lock-up financial product launched by LBank. Users cannot redeem funds early during the lock-up period and, in return, can obtain relatively stable returns.
How are Locked Earn returns generated?
Locked Earn returns come from the platform’s periodic operation of locked assets and the yield pricing mechanism corresponding to the lock-up period, as well as promotional rewards that LBank may provide through marketing campaigns. Returns are calculated according to the rules after the product is established and are settled uniformly on the settlement date.
Why haven’t I received my returns yet?
Common reasons include: the product is still in the lock-up period and returns have not yet been settled; the settlement date has not been reached; returns are distributed uniformly after settlement rather than daily. Please refer to the settlement date displayed on the product page.
When can I redeem the tokens I previously invested?
Locked Earn must be held until the end of the lock-up period. Upon reaching the settlement date, the principal and returns will be returned according to the rules. Early redemption is generally not supported during the lock-up period (if supported, returns will be affected).
How to participate in Locked Earn?
1. Visit and log in to LBank official website;
2. Go to “Earn” > “Locked”.
3. Click “Join now” to subscribe to a Locked product and start earning fixed returns.

Headline: CFD Super Wednesday (Round 5): Call XAUUSD up or down. Share a prize pool of up to $10,000!

## Notes
This promotion is only available in select regions. Users must use the Join Now button to complete registration before they can participate.
Trading lot size is calculated based on actual CFD positions opened during the promotion period; pending orders that are not filled and canceled orders will not be counted.
Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within 5 working days after the promotion ends.
This promotion is exclusive to regular users. Sub-accounts, institutional users, PRO accounts, and market makers are not eligible to participate.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
Bitget will conduct a review of all users and promptly disqualify those who employ any technical means, including but not limited to electronic, robotic, repetitive, or automated methods, for the purpose of automated or repeated registration and participation, and confiscate their rewards.
Due to legal and regulatory requirements, some users may be unable to sign up for a Bitget account, or access may be temporarily restricted in certain countries or regions. Refer to Bitget's terms and conditions for the latest information.
Bitget reserves the right to amend, revise, or cancel this promotion at any time without prior notice, at its sole discretion. Bitget reserves the right to the final interpretation of this promotion. Contact customer service if you have any questions.

Venue: Binance
Headline: Spot Trading Tournament Season 11: Trade to Share Up to 5,000,000 NIGHT Token Vouchers

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Disclaimer: This is not available for users in the EEA.
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is thrilled to launch a Spot Trading Tournament where eligible users will have a chance to share a total prize pool of 5,000,000 NIGHT (Midnight) in token vouchers!
In addition, Binance is introducing a “Sprint Reward” for a limited period – the more you trade, the higher your extra rewards!
Promotion Period: 2026-11-25 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-02 10:00 (UTC)
Join Now
## Eligibility
All verified new, regular users and Binance VIP 1-6 users can participate.
Liquidity providers in the Binance Spot Liquidity Provider Program and Binance Brokers are not eligible to participate.
## Eligible Trading Pair(s)
Trading pair(s): XRP/USDC, NIGHT/USDT
## How to Participate
Click the [Join Now] button on the landing page to register.
Total Trading Volume reaches at least 500 USD equivalent in any of the aforementioned eligible pair(s) on Binance Spot during the Promotion Period. Users who do not meet this threshold will not qualify for any reward under this Trading Volume Tournament.
## Main Reward Structure
Statistical Period: 2026-11-25 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-02 10:00 (UTC)
Rankings Based on the Cumulative Trading Volume | Reward per Eligible Participant (in NIGHT Token Vouchers)
1st Place | 150,000 NIGHT
2nd Place | 125,000 NIGHT
3rd Place | 100,000 NIGHT
4th Place | 75,000 NIGHT
5th Place | 50,000 NIGHT
6th - 20th Places | An equal split of 500,000 NIGHT
21st - 50th Places | An equal split of 500,000 NIGHT
51st - 200th Places | An equal split of 1,300,000 NIGHT
201st - 1,000th Places | An equal split of 700,000 NIGHT
All Remaining Eligible Participants | A proportional share* of 1,000,000 NIGHT, capped at 600 NIGHT per user
Proportional Share Rewards Calculation Logic*: Your Final Allocation = (Your Trading Volume / Total Trading Volume of All Eligible Participants Ranked after the 1,000th) * Proportional Share Prize Pool
## Sprint Reward Structure
Binance is introducing a “Sprint Reward”. For a limited period, users will receive extra rewards based on their ranking by cumulative trading volume. The more one trades during the respective Statistical Periods, the higher the extra rewards can be. Please note that users can earn from both the "Sprint Reward" and the "Main Reward" pools at the same time.
Rankings Based on the Cumulative Trading Volume | Round 1 Statistical Period: 2026-11-25 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-27 10:00 (UTC) | Round 2 Statistical Period: 2026-11-27 10:01 (UTC) to 2026-11-29 10:00 (UTC)
Reward per Eligible Participant (in NIGHT Token Vouchers)
1st Place | 75,000 NIGHT | 75,000 NIGHT
2nd Place | 62,500 NIGHT | 62,500 NIGHT
3rd Place | 50,000 NIGHT | 50,000 NIGHT
4th Place | 37,500 NIGHT | 37,500 NIGHT
5th Place | 25,000 NIGHT | 25,000 NIGHT
## Promotion Rules
Trading volume of any zero-fee trading pairs is excluded from the final trading volume calculation.
Transaction or gas fees will be excluded from the final trading volume calculation for the tournament.
All eligible buy and sell orders will be counted towards the cumulative total trading volume.
Token vouchers will be distributed to winners by 2026-12-16, and will expire within 21 days after distribution. Users will be able to login and redeem their token voucher rewards via Profile > Rewards Hub.
The Spot Trading Volume leaderboard is updated at least once every 24 hours. The final update will be completed within a few hours after the campaign ends. The Main Reward leaderboard and Sprint Reward leaderboard will be displayed on the separate Sub-Spot landing page respectively. Data sync times vary daily but will always be completed by the end of the day.
Only users who have met the minimum qualifying trading volume threshold will be displayed on the leaderboard along with their trading volume.
Don’t miss out on this opportunity and share in the rewards now! To view more promotions on Binance, stay tuned to this page for the latest updates and exclusive opportunities.
## Guides & Related Materials
How to Spot Trade (App / Web)
## Terms & Conditions
Only verified users who complete the aforementioned criteria for the tournament by the end of the Promotion Period may receive rewards.
This Trading Volume Tournament is available to verified new, regular and VIP 1 - 6 users enabled for Binance Spot Trading, subject to product (and where relevant, deposit methods’) availability in users’ regions, and may be restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions, or to certain users, due to legal and regulatory requirements.
VIP level eligibility will be determined based on the user's VIP level at the time of joining the Activity. Users who join the Activity while they are VIP 6 or below will remain eligible for the Activity and may receive the applicable rewards based on their eligible trading volume during the Promotion Period, even if their VIP level is upgraded to VIP 7 or above during the Promotion Period.
## Reward Distribution:
All token voucher rewards will be distributed to eligible, winning users by 2026-12-16.
Users will be able to login and redeem their token voucher rewards via Profile > Rewards Hub.
All token voucher rewards will expire within 21 days after distribution. Winning users should claim their vouchers before the expiration date, and no replacement reward will be provided. Learn how to redeem a Binance voucher.
Please note that the actual value of rewards received by a user is subject to change due to market fluctuation.
Token voucher rewards are subject to additional terms and conditions.
Rewards are not negotiable nor transferable.
Once the available rewards have been allocated to users, no further rewards will be provided notwithstanding that an eligible user may have completed the missions.
A user’s trading volume in this Trading Volume Tournament will be calculated after the user has opted-in and will be based on the trading volume (i) in their master and sub-accounts, and (ii) on all Spot products, including Spot Trading, Spot Copy Trading and Trading Bots. API trades are allowed. Binance’s calculation of a user’s trading volume is final.
The commencement and operation of the campaign (including the commencement of the Promotion Period) are subject to the successful listing of the relevant token on Binance Spot. If the listing is postponed or cancelled for any reason, the campaign (including the Promotion Period and reward distribution) may be delayed, amended or withdrawn at Binance’s discretion. Binance will not be liable for any loss or inconvenience caused by such changes.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.

## On the exchange page
Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 150 million users with access to millions of crypto tokens, tokenized stocks, ETFs, and other real-world assets.
The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI-powered trading tools, interoperability across markets, and broader access to real-world assets.

Our story
Bitget was founded on the steadfast belief in being among the final 10% who stay committed, even in the face of adversity.
With a background in traditional finance, Bitget’s founding team discovered blockchain technology in 2015, but it was viewed as "tulip mania" by the industry back then. In 2018, we became intrigued by cryptocurrency after studying the Bitcoin whitepaper and Ethereum ecosystem. We believed that cryptocurrency would play an important role in the future and even benefit the unbanked groups. However, the market crash chased away most speculators and less than 10% of the people chose to stick to their convictions and rebuild. Bitget was then officially founded in the same year.
Born in a bear market, Bitget insists on putting users first, focusing on product innovation, and advocating long-term development with the spirit of earnestness. Our goal is to empower more people to embrace crypto and make smarter trades—one step at a time.

We believe in a more equitable future world driven by crypto evolution.
